verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verse_spoken: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God,
that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not;
and it shall be given him.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you today because I need your wisdom.
You promised to give generously to all who ask, so I am asking now.
There are choices in front of me that I cannot see clearly on my own.
Quiet the noise in my mind and help me hear your voice above the rest.
Give me wisdom for my work, my family, my money and my words.
Keep me from rushing ahead in fear or pride.
Teach me to slow down, to listen, and to trust what you show me.
Let my decisions today bring you honour and bring peace to those around me.
Give wisdom to everyone praying with me, and lead each of us one step at a time.
